text:
sam: FYI scheduling a rolling kubelet livepatch + safe reboot in eu-central next Thu 01:30-04:00 UTC. Scope: 6 racks (racks 7-12) across two AZs. Root cause: CVE mitigation in kernel-net and node-level kubelet memory leak observed under long-running mutable-mounts. Expect brief pod reschedules and cached model cold-starts.

olivia: Will dedicated pools be touched? any SLA impact?

sam: Dedicated/reserved pools are out of scope — well only touch shared inference pools and optional batch workers. SLA for reserved customers unchanged. Non-reserved tenants might see short tail increases while their pods reschedule.

diego: Capacity question 1% of shared GPU capacity will be unavailable in-eu during peak of the window if we do two-rack cohorts in parallel. Recommend serial cohorts (one rack every 20m) to keep impact under 8-10%.

sam: Well do serial cohorts. Plan: cordon+drain 1 rack -> reboot nodes -> validate kubelet + nvml metrics -> uncordon. Target cadence: 20m per rack including a 5m post-uncordon observation.

maria: Can we pre-warm local model caches and seed KV to reduce cold-start pressure? Also defer heavy retrain/eval jobs in eu region for that night.

sam: yes to both. Action: @infra-bot tag maintenance + @ml-platform pause scheduled evals 01:00-06:00 UTC. Also well run warm-cache job 30m prior to first cordon.

infra-bot: Maintenance ticket created: eu-central-kubelet-livepatch-2026-09-16. ID: 6491234567. Details: https://console.internal/maint/6491234567 (auto).

alex: Network note: avoid cross-AZ cross-attach during drain to limit extra egress. If we need backfill, prefer intra-region spare capacity in eu-west with explicit routing rules. Cross-region backfill (us-west) is last resort.

diego: Cost calc: spinning ~15 spare GPUs in eu-west for 3 hours ~ ~$900 (compute + small egress). If we pull from us-west it's ~ $1.7k.

maria: What are the rollback thresholds?

sam: Rollback if any of these within 15 minutes of a cohort: p99 latency +200ms vs baseline, error rate +0.5% absolute, node reboot failures >2 in rack, or GPU temp delta >8C after reboot. Also manual approval required before expanding beyond 2 racks.

olivia: Add a 10-minute human pause after first 2 racks. We can't rely solely on automated checks.

sam: added. Runbook snippets below for ops on the day:

```bash
# cordon rack nodes (example)
kubectl label nodes node-eu-r07{01..08} maintenance=scheduled
for n in node-eu-r07{01..08}; do kubectl cordon $n; kubectl drain $n --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=240 -n inference; done
# run quick nvml check
ssh ops@node-eu-r071 "nvidia-smi --query-gpu=temperature.gpu,utilization.gpu --format=csv,noheader"
# reboot and apply kernel patch
ssh ops@node-eu-r071 "sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y linux-image-patched && sudo reboot"
```

alex: We'll also flip a temporary route to eu-west spare pool for tail-sensitive models. Liaise with router team to pre-populate route maps 1h before start.

diego: Who's oncall? I can take infra-watch. Need someone for network and ML perf.

sam: @alex will own network; @maria owns ML perf checks; @diego infra-watch. Please ACK by EOD.

alex: ACK 44d Ill prepare route-map and rollback play for egress caps.

maria: ACK 44d Ill make a quick dashboard for p50/p95/p99 and cold-starts to watch during the window.

diego: ACK 44d Ill prepare canary checklist and extra spare nodes in eu-west (15 nodes).

sam: Final note: we'll publish a short customer blurb for non-reserved tenants 48h before with expected window + contact. If anyone has third-party peering limits in eu-central, shout now. Moving to schedule if no objections.

olivia: no objections from me.

sam: scheduling confirmed. :calendar:
